fact: The appraisal document, dated 4 May 2011, treats a National ICT Policy as existing, with the project coordination unit to monitor its implementation and the steering committee to check project activities against it; the document does not describe the policy's scope.

The project coordination unit, anchored in the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications in charge of ICT (MPTNTC), is to monitor implementation of the National ICT Policy and the government's ICT strategy, per the 2011 appraisal document.

The Council of Ministers communique of 6 March 2019 has the minister say the electronic transactions bill follows the national ICT development policy that the government drew up in 2008-2009; it does not use the word adopted, and the document gives no date of adoption.
